chapter: Later bands, Joe Turner and records
title: Danny Barker and the taxi dance
summary: Meeting Danny Barker when visiting the taxi dance and Octave Crosby's story.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: Did you know Danny Barco down here? Yeah.

I met Danny Barco. He came... He was a good friend to Octave Crosby. Mm-hmm. Because I was told Danny Barco was playing the taxi dance when he left here. That's what I was told. Mm-hmm. And went away. And he came back to the taxi dance during the time when he was playing with Cab Calloway to visit us. Mm-hmm. And that's how I got a chance to meet him. And after that, doing those parades he used to be out when he came back to live here.
I remind him that I knew him, you know.
And after I got to know him, you know. He got to know me at least because I knew him, but... Yeah.
I was with you that day.
Yeah. Mm-hmm. Yeah, I knew him.
Where were you at then? Where was he at the dance hall at La Vida or Farron or what?
I don't know what dance hall he was at. But he was at one. But Octave Crosby told me that Danny Barco would come back home because he used to play this with me. Right here, taxi dance.
